process.title: What happens after you submit
process.step1: You submit the form with your business details.
process.step2: Our team reviews your request and reaches out to coordinate next steps. This usually takes 24 to 48 business hours.
process.step3: We email you to coordinate adding your business to the platform.
process.step4: You create your account, complete the listing, and choose your plan.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How much does it cost to list my food business on Hospeda?
faq.a1_one: One fixed monthly payment, with a {{count}}-day free trial. No commission on bookings or inquiries.
faq.a1_other: One fixed monthly payment, with a {{count}}-day free trial. No commission on bookings or inquiries.
faq.a1NoTrial: One fixed monthly payment. No commission on bookings or inquiries.
faq.a2: No. You can cancel your subscription anytime from your account.
faq.q3: How many listings can I publish?
faq.a3: The plan includes one gastronomy listing per account.
